roi_estimate.description: Specific ROI description tied to this company

investment_value_usd.description: Total estimated USD cost to implement end-to-end over 12-24 months. Includes software licences, integration cost, dedicated headcount fraction × salary, opportunity cost of redirected effort. Pass null when you cannot ground the number in the provided context — null is preferred over a hallucinated guess.

roi_estimate_pct.description: Estimated ROI percentage in the range 0..500. Computed as (annualised_value_created - annualised_cost) / annualised_cost * 100. A 50%% ROI means the opportunity returns 1.5x its cost in year one. Pass null when you cannot ground the number in the provided context — null is preferred over a hallucinated guess.
